description:
Multi-day passes and per-day tickets on shared capacity (zones/stages), festival camping add-ons bound to the order, RFID wristband media with activation/binding (hardware simulated in the testbed).

**Conditions of Success:**
- Full-festival pass and day tickets draw down shared capacity consistently
- Wristband activation binds media to a ticket/person; lost wristband reissue deactivates the old one
- Festival camping sold only with a qualifying festival order

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
